title: Kroger Product Scraper
description: Extract structured Kroger product data from a search URL or keyword, including prices, availability, ratings, images, nutrition, and aisle information.

startUrl.title: Kroger search or product URL
startUrl.description: Optional Kroger search URL or product URL. When supplied, its query parameters are used. Use keyword when no URL is supplied.

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Search term used when a URL is not supplied, for example cream, milk, or cereal.

results_wanted.title: Results wanted
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of products to save.

max_pages.title: Maximum search pages
max_pages.description: Maximum number of 24-product search pages to request.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional Apify Proxy configuration for requests to Kroger.
